tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje mkha' spyod dbang pos mdzad pa'i ma mgon zhal sbyor gyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs rgyan dbang dang bcas pa'i yig sna gnyis gab sprad 'khrugs bsal bltas chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so//

bla ma he ru ka dpal la// btud de nag po chen po yi// dbang chog nye bar sbas pa dag /'gro la phan phyir gsal bar bri// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral la// btud de de yi man ngag gis// smin byed cho ga rnam par bsdu// de la rigs bsdus dang*/ bde dbang dang*/ phrin las te gsum gyi spyi dang bye brag gi cho ga las/ 'dir ni phyi ma'i phyi ma ste/ dur khrod sogs gnas ji ltar rigs par sa yi cho ga mdor bsdus pa sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ gru gsum mthing nag 'khor lo bzhi rim dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas par mngon rtogs nas bshad pa lta bu'am/ bsdus pa na gru gsum thod ra rdo ra me ri dang bcas pa tsam la brten pas kyang rung ste/ dbus su rten gyi gri gug dgod/ byang phyogs su rten rgyun thun gyi ba ling bshams/ khrag gi arghaṃ sogs mchod rdzas kyi bye brag du mas bskor/ yi dam mam dpal chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i bum chu sta gon bya/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga la sogs kyi gzhung bsrang*/ 'di nyid kyi mchod pa'i rim pa cho ga bzhin zhag gsum mam bdun sogs byas la/ sgrub pa po sngon du dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ dpal nag po chen po dang*/ bla ma yi dam tha dad du mi sems pa'i dad pa can/ gsang chen rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig la lhag par spyod pas/ rigs bzhi'i dam tshig rab tu brtan pa can de dag /'di nyid kyis dbang nod par 'dod pas bla ma la maṇḍal phul te gsol ba btab par bya'o// sa'i cho ga ci rigs pa dang ldan pas stegs bu bya zhing thig gi cho gas thig gdab/ snyan gsan dbab/ chos 'byung mthing nag gi dbus su pad 'dab bzhi/ lte ba nag shar dkar/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ste 'di ni rigs bsdus so// rigs so so la ni so so'i tshon spungs sam sa bon nam mtshan ma/ sku sngags/ rgyan phyag mtshan/ gar nyams/

phrin las gsang ba'i sku dang*/ pad snod dang*/ ḍākki'i sku dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ gri gug rnams so so'am/ tshang ba sogs ji ltar rigs par bkod/ zla gam dmar/ mu khyud thod phreng dkar/ sgo sgo rgyan ci rigs la/ dur khrod rdo ra me ri dang bcas pa bri/ bye brag mngon rtogs ltar na/ 'khor lo bzhi rim la sogs pa'o// mchod pa'i bkod pa dang*/ ba ling gsum sogs phun sum tshogs pa bshams/ mi bskyod pa sogs kyi bdag nyid rigs kyi mgon por bum pa bskyed bzlas bdud rtsir bya ba rgyal byed dang*/ phrin las kyi mgon po'i las kyi bum pa byin gyis brlabs la shar zur du bkod/ de dang nye bar thod pa bdud rtsi sindhū ra'i maṇḍal ji lta bar bshams/ srung 'khor sngon du 'gro bas bdag mdun bskyed bzlas mchod bstod sogs gzhung bzhin byas la slob dpon bdag nyid kyis dbang blangs te/ yol ba'i phyi rol du bgegs bsal ba dang*/ maṇḍal phyag skor sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag mdun bskyed bzlas ni/ bdag bskyed phag mo'am rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs kyis cho ga'i gzhung bsrang nas/ mdun bskyed mgon po mtshal ser gang rung gzhung ltar btang*/ rnam rgyal bum par mgon po rigs bsdus yab yum zhal sbyor gtso 'khor lnga rkang thang bskyed/ las bum du phrin las kyi mgon po ljang gu yab rkyang rung mod kyis/ 'di ni pakshi'i yab chos rnying ma rang yin pas yi dam gzhan mi dgos par mtshal ser gnyis gang rung*/ mngon rtogs tshar gcig gis bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum bskyed/ gtor ma lhar bskyed pa dang thams cad dus gcig la bskyed nas mchod bstod bzlas pa byas pas 'thus pa rnying ma'i lugs grub chen karma pakshi'i bzhed pa yin/ de'i tshe sngags kyang zhal sbyor gsung gi snying po rang bzlas pas 'thus/ las bum ni don ldan zhabs kyis bzhed pa ltar/ bhrūm̐ las las bum nang du hūm̐ yig las// dran rdzogs dam ye dbyer med las mgon ni// mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag ni bcu gnyis pa// g.yas dmar g.yon dkar dbus mthing khro bo'i zhal// rgyab zhal phag gdong ljang gu dbu skra 'bar// sbom thung gsus 'phyang zhabs bzhi 'dor thabs bsgrad// dang po'i phyag gnyis yum 'khyud ma mchu btsir// de 'og gnyis kyis gri gug rnga yab dkar// gsum pas rdo rje rtse gcig kha ṭwām̐ ga

/bzhi pas tho ba dang ni thod pa ste// lnga pa gnyis kyis glang chen pags pa brgyangs// drug gnyis rdo rje log 'dren mche ba 'dzin// bdud bzhi mnan cing ma he'i steng na bzhengs// de ltar dmigs la yid kyis mchod bstod dang*/ daṃṣṭotka ṭa ci 'grub bzlas par bya/ de ni lnga bcu pa yi rgyud las gsungs/ mdun bskyed mchod bstod sogs gzhung bzhin byas la/ slob dpon bdag nyid kyis dbang blangs te/ rang don yin na bdag 'jug rgyas par blangs/ gzhan phyogs mgyogs dbang la ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang blangs la bum chu btung yang chog /byin rlabs nod par 'dod pa dag yol ba'i phyi rol du bgegs bsal ba'i gtor ma btang*/ bgegs bskrad de mtshams bcad la/ bskor ba dang phyag sngon du 'gro bas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa khyed kyis bdag la dpal nag po chen po'i dbang gi bka' drin mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsum/ bla mas/ slob ma gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje mthing nag rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur pa la badzra pā ṇi dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ye shes pa dpag tu med pa thim zhing mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum gyi byin gyis brlab par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nyid la/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ lcang lo can gyi sogs/ sngags 'di zlos shig /oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐/ lus lha ngag sngags sems ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral bar gyis shig /ces gdams/ de yan ni sa chog ma byas pa'i gong du bya rgyu yin kyang mchog dbang skabs 'dir lhag chad med phyir 'dir sbyar ba'o// khrus byas yid ches lo rgyus ni/ da lam khyed rnams la ma mgon zhal sbyor gyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs bskur ba la/ thog mar lo rgyus zhu ba ni rnal 'byor kun gyi mgon gyur yin// ngo bo ye shes sprul pa las// ye shes sku ste rdo rje che// zhes gsungs pa dang*// rgyud de nyid las bcom ldan 'das dpal mgon po nag po zhes bya ba gsang ba'i yum dang bcas pa zhes gsungs pa dang*// rgyud me lce phreng ba'i dbus 'gyur phyogs la yang*// bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nag po chen po dang thabs gcig pa la phyag 'tshol/

ces dang*/ grub chen karma pas/ dpal gyi mgon po ber nag can dang*/ ming yongs su grags pa'i karma pa gnyis tha dad med pa khyed rnams kyis shes sam mi shes gsungs pa'i bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ yi dam mgon po dbyer med yin la/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi yum dbyangs can ma/ gshin rje gshed kyi yum ro langs ma/ mgon po'i yum rang byung rgyal mo de rnams ngo bo gcig pa rgyud sde du ma nas gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad ma mgon zhal sbyor 'di la 'dus pa'i phyir 'di la gong non yi dam gzhan mi dgos/ mal gyo lo tsā ba'i lugs yab rkyang*/ dus mkhyen gyi lugs yum rkyang gnyis ka 'di la 'dus/ 'khor dregs pa'i gtso bo bdun cu rtsa gnyis sogs bka' srung thams cad kyang 'di la ma 'dus pa med/ 'di la rgyud gnyis te/ slob dpon padma srin po'i kha gnon la 'byon gsungs nas byon pa'i tshe gser brdzangs bcas rgyal blon gyis bskyal/ skyel ma tshur log nub mi nag po gcig gis khyed kyis slob dpon la sgrub mi dgos pa'i mthu yod pa mi zhu ci yin zer/ rgyal pos rin po che sogs bkal te rjes bsnyegs pas chu bar der slebs/ chibs chen gsum dang nor bu phul nas zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis nga la ma mgon gyi par nag gcig yod de lho nub srin po'i kha gnon la 'gro dus 'di nged la dgos gsungs nas ma gnang bar bzhud/ rgyal po phyi nas 'brang*/ drang srong srin rigs sgo rtsar slebs dus zhus pas ma gnang nas rgyal po la spyan chab byung nas gnang*/ khyed rang gi sku srung gyis/ gzhan la ma spel gsungs pas nyid rang las ma spel/ sras sad na legs/ sad na 'gying yon gnyis yod pa las/ sad na legs mis bsad nas sad na 'gying yon tan gyis bod kyi mkhas btsun rnams gdan drangs/ ma mgon par bu zhag nyer gcig la bsgrubs pas dgra po rnams phyag myal song*/

sras sad na legs bkum pa'i 'bangs bsad/ sad na 'gying yon la sras gsum gyi chung ba stag nam mkha'i lha bzung de/ o rgyan bi ma nam mkha'i snying po gsum gyis dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs/ sngags bod du bsgyur tshad la mnga' brnyes dngos grub thob/ na bza' nyi ma'i srab mda' la 'gel ba dang*/ 'ja' 'od thang la zug pa la 'ju zhing kun gyis mthong bar nam mkhar 'gro nus/ khyad par rdo rje srin po drag po pho dgu mo dgu 'khor bcas tha dad med pa ste/ stag nam mkha'i lha bzung man chad yongs su grags pa'i karma pa yan chad/ sngags pa tshe ring*/ shos mi rabs bcu gsum dang*/ mi rabs bco lnga ming yongs su grags pa karma pa badzra lakṣa yan du/ gdams ngag gong 'og rnams 'dzam bu gling gi rgyal po rgyal brgyud la sogs pa thams cad kyis mthong ba dang thos pa dang*/ phyi snod nang bcud kyi sems can rnams la phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du rtags bstan pa rnams phyi bzhin sba ba dang gsang ma btub par bstan pa'o// zhes gsungs/ ḍombi he ru ka la ma mgon rgyud brgya rtsa brgyad kyi don bsdus de mdzad pa rtsa rlung gi gdams ngag dang bcas pa snyan brgyud/ tai lo nā ro pa nas mar par brgyud de stod las byang chub sgrub pa/ rlung sems gnad kyi 'khor lo/ lho brag pa'i mgon po bde bang ma zhes bya ste/ bla med he ru ka phrin las su bsgrub pa'i utpal do shal bka' rgya can/ 'di mar mi dwags po dus mkhyen la brgyud de/ ras chen mgon po'i man ngag la mkhas pa'i thugs rgyal mnga' ba/ dus mkhyen gyis 'di snyan brgyud du gnang bas/ mal gyo lugs la chos shin tu zab par dgongs te thugs rgyal chags/ kaṃ tshang la lhag par thugs dad nas don brgyud 'dzin par gyur/ zhes mkha' spyod pas gsungs te rje zla 'od gzhon nu las byung ba'i mgon po dpal dus gsum mkhyen pa rin po ches sbas te/ 'gro mgon ras chen la bstan/

gnyal pa jo sras las byung ba las kyang khyad par du 'phags par dgongs te/ rab tu gsang nas gcig brgyud du bstan gsungs/ 'don cha zhal sbyor 'di dngos brgyud gang nas byung zhu na/ drag po lha rgyud gsang ba chen po las/ zhal sbyor sku gsung thugs kyi sngags ring dang bcas pa/ zhal sbyor par bu skor thabs rgyas par byung ba la brten nas o rgyan rin po ches mgon po ber nag gi sgrub thabs mdzad pa rnying ma grub chen karma pakshi'i yab chos yin pa'i zhal sbyor ḍombis mdzad pa'i snyan brgyud de gsar ma drag po'i dngos bstan rgyud las gsal te rin chen dpung rgyan rgyud las/ bai ta li dang yang dag bsten// g.yon tu 'khril ba yum gyi tshul// zhes dang*/ nag po chen po srog gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po lha mo nag mo gnyis su med/ ces gsungs pa'i don yin/ slob dpon arna pa'i lugs yab rkyang gi sgrub skor thams cad dang*/ dar ma rin chen gyi gter ma lha mo rang byung ma skor gsum/ sad na 'gying yon gyi gter ma yab yum zhal sbyor/ lho brag gi snyan brgyud mgon po/ ye shes mgon po legs ldan ber nag can/ las kyi mgon po sras mchog ber nag can/ 'jig rten mgon po dregs byed ber nag can/ ber nag can skor gsum/ rgyud gur dang hūm̐ mdzad nag po can dang*/ mgon po zangs gri can te gri gug skor gsum/ de thams cad 'di la tshang*/ yab yum sbrags sgrub 'di bkra shis shing tshan che ba'i zab gnad pakshi nyid kyi zhal gzigs byung ba la brten nas sgrub pa'i gzhung mdzad pa yin pas bka' babs byin rlabs can gyi brgyud pa yin te grub chen karma pakshi nyid kyi zhal nas/ pho rgyud mgon po/ mo rgyud ma mo rtsa ba kun gyi gtso bo de/ yab legs ldan mgon po ber nag can las thams cad 'phros pa ste/ bstan srung nag po chen po ber nag dang*/ ber med gri gug thod can dang*/

phyag bzhi pa dang*/ phyag drug pa dang*/ zhal phyag grangs med pa rnams mgon po 'di'i sprul pa dang yang sprul rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul yin pas kun gyis shes par mdzod/ de ltar mngon sum tshad mar mgon po ber nag can ma mgon lcam dral dngos su 'grub pa'i ming yongs su grags pa'i karma pa yin/ khyed rnams kyis shes sam mi shes/ khyod rnams kyang brgyud pa 'dzin cing bsgrub na 'grub te mchis/ ma mgon gnyis kyi dpe'u bum mang po yod pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus shing bsdoms pa 'di yin pas/ da phyin chad thams cad kyis 'di la bris shing bsgrub na byin rlabs che zhing thams cad ma lus pa med pa 'di la tshang bas go bar gyis/ gdams ngag la shes dgos sam mi shes dgos/ gdams ngag 'di shin tu zab drags pas dpe gzhung gzhan rnams don yod med dkrugs pa 'dra ba min pas shes par gyis/ 'di'i gnad ma shes lo brgyar bsgrub kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung ba zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ brgyud pa bzhi karma pakshi la 'dus te/ o rgyan rin po che'i lung bstan las/ bsil ba tshal gyi chos skyong gi /rnam 'phrul karma pa zhes grags// skye ba mang po 'gro don dpag med byed// ces lung bstan du mar gnang*/ grub chen nyid kyi zhal nas dpal mgon ber can 'di dang ming yongs su grags pa'i karma pa gnyis tha mi dad pas shes sam mi shes/ de phyir dus gsum dus med thams cad du mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa 'di bya ba phrin las thams cad sgrub pa yin pa kun gyis shes par mdzod/ ces gsungs phyir pakshi yan chad brgyud pa 'ded mi dgos/ de la yab rkyang rjes gnang dang*/ gtor dbang dang*/ 'gro mgon ras chen gyi dbang chog chen mo dang*/ yum rkyang gi dbang ni kun la grags kyang yab yum zhal sbyor gyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa 'di ni gcig brgyud ma gtogs yi ger bkod pa med pa las/ rje mkha' spyod dbang po la rdo rje phag mos lung bstan nas/

nag rgyal phag gsum gyi snyan brgyud yi ger bkod pa 'di'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa ma yig gnyis bkod/ de dag mkha' spyod dbang pos mdzad pa rtogs ldan lugs su grags/ de tshe mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs chen pos/ 'di 'dra gzhung rgyud kyi dpe cha la med pas rang bzo yin zhes bkag pa mdzad/ khong rang gis snyan brgyud med pa'i gzhung dngos bstan de mdzad/ 'di'i zhal sbyor gyi dbang bzhi rgyas par mdzad/ de dag ni mgon nyob ma la sbyar rgyu yin pa'i/ rje dkon mchog yan lag gi zhal sbyor gyi sgrub thabs shog dril las mtha' tha dag rnam par snang bar byed pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i nang na'ang*/ deng sang gi mgon po'i cho ga 'byar ba'i phyir/ don ldan gyis dbang chog ma bris par/ mang nyung 'tshams zhing deng sang gi cho ga dang 'brel nas/ mkha' spyod pas dbang chog gnyis po bris par mdzad/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyis bka' gnang ba ltar mgon nyob ma nas bsdus te/ deng sang gi mtshal dmar ser gyi dpe tshan gsum 'di bsgrigs nas gsar du bkod par mdzad pa'i mgon po shin tu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul che ba ste/ rgyud me lce phreng ba las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mgon po nag po la bka' stsal pa// skyes bu khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul ni// srid pa gsum la byol 'debs shing*// khams gsum dbang du sdud par byed// 'dod khams dkrugs shing zil gyis gnon// stong gsum gzhan du 'phen par byed// 'byung po kun gyi rgyu lam gcod// rgya mtsho chen po hub kyis 'debs// ri bo lto ru za bar byed// dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar gcod cing*// khyod kyi gad mor bgad pa yi// bzhad pa'i gad mos lha rnams brgyal// bdud dang mu stegs sngangs bar byed// shi la thug pa brgyal bar 'gyur// ngo mtshar gad mos dbang du bsdus// ma mo'i tshogs rnams yid kyang 'phrog /hūm̐ sgras khams gsum dbang du sdud// phaṭa kyis stong gsum dus gcig sgrol// pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ gyis 'jig rten g.yo// g.yo ba thams cad dbang du sdud// dbang gi stobs kyis glog dang 'dra// stong gsum dus gcig khyab par 'gro// mngon shes lnga dang rab ldan cing*// rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs rab bstan nas// 'gro ba log 'dren sgrol bar byed// mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso bo ste// dur khrod kun gyi bdag po ste// lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po ste// zhing skyong dpa' po'i dmag dpon mdzad// gshin rje bdud kyi rje bor mdzad// gnod sbyin kun kyang bran du 'khor// de ltar dpal ldan ded dpon khyod// ces gsungs so// rin chen dpung rgyan las/

gang tshe ci yis 'dul par shes pa'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ srog gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ mgon po nyid kyis smras pa/ e ma ho/ bdag ni shin tu mi srun pa// srin po rnams kyang bran tu 'khor// lha ma yin rnams rlag par byed// lha srin sde brgyad 'khor du bca'// lha ma yin gyi bu mo rnams// srin mor bcas de khas blangs nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung du bcug /ces so// deng sang mgon po la mthu mi 'dug ces smra ba de don ma go ste/ mgon po 'don mkhan mang yang dbang lung thob pa dang*/ phyag len mi shes pa/ bsnyen sgrub ma them pa'i lan yin te/ gnam chos lung bstan las/ da a kha kha thang nag dang gcig /pha med las kyi ri gon pa dang gnyis/ zer nas kun gyis skyo skyo byed// ces gsungs/ skyo mi dgos khong gnyis po gcig yin/ ces sogs 'byung ba lta bu'o// khyad par du rang byung rgyal mo'i thugs gsang ba'i rgyud las/ gzhan yang ma mo sangs rgyas kyi bstan srung khas blangs te 'di skad du/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos rin chen lta bu mngon pa sogs sde snod rnam gsum la/ gang zhig mos shing dad pas yid ches pa'i gang zag de la bsrung ba dang bskyab par bgyi'o// gang zhig 'chad pa dang*/ nyan pa dang*/ klog cing kun chub par byed pa dang*/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de'i sbyor ba ngan pa bsal bar bgyi/ gang bsgom pa dang*/ sgrub pa nyams su len pa de la gang du/ pho nya dus rtag tu bya/ de ltar dam bcas bzhin tu bdag gis ma bgyid na/ bdag gis da lta nyid du bcom ldan 'das bslus pa yin lags so// de'i dbang gis rang gi snying la me 'bar nas lus srog thal ba bzhin tu 'tshig par 'gyur la mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por 'gyur/ ces smon lam gdab cing mna' bor/ de'i gnad kyis deng sang dus ci ltar snyigs kyang gnas pa bsgom pa dam tshig can thams cad la dpal ldan lha mos srung zhing skyob pa'i rtags dang nyams rmi lam kun tu gsal ba 'dug pa 'di ga yin/

de ltar brgyud pa bzhi po 'di brgyud tshul bshad ma dgos gong gis gsal ba ltar yin la/ zhal sbyor dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ grub chen karma pakshi nas mnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum/ rang byung rdo rje/ grags pa seng ge/ dar ma rgyal mtshan/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ chos kyi bha dra/ chos dpal ye shes/ mthong ba don ldan/ dpal 'byor don grub/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ mnyan pa grub chen/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ dkon mchog yan lag /stag lung pa/ rnam rgyal dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub/ mnyan pa'i sku sprul bde legs snying po/ de nyid kyi zhal snga nas phyag len 'don 'grigs dbang dag par lan gsum/ bdag a rā gas zhus/ yang khong gis drung pa rgyal tshab pa la gsan gsung*/ mchan bu ltar na/ dkon mchog yan lag /dbang phyug rdo rje/ chos kyi dbang phyug /grags pa mchog dbyangs/ mnyan pa'i sprul sku'o// yang na/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ mtshur phu slob dpon mgon po rgyal/ 'jam dpal bzang po/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ par nag shog dril gsum pa ltar/ yang na mi bskyod rdo rje nas/ si tu chos kyi go cha/ mi 'khrug dpal bzang*/ de'i mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug la brgyud/ yang na/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ bkra shis don 'grub/ sgom mkhan shākya bzang po/ chos kyi go cha des/ bdag badzra shwa ra la'o// yab yum zhal sbyor gyi brgyud pa ni/ karma pa/ bla ma gnyan ras/ rang byung rdo rje/ mgon po rgyal mtshan/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ grags pa seṅge/ dar ma rgyal mtshan/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ kun dga' blo gros/ rin chen bzang po/ dharma bha dra/ chos dpal bzang po/ mthong ba don ldan/ dpal 'byor don 'grub/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ bkra shis dpal 'byor/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ dkon mchog yan lag /dbang phyug rdo rje/ chos kyi dbang phyug /ngag dbang 'jigs med grags ba nyid kyi zhal snga nas mtshal ser yongs rdzogs kyi lung bdag a rā gas gsan/

yang dbang phyug rdo rje nas si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma chos ldan rab 'byor gyi zhal snga nas mtshal ser yongs rdzogs kyi lung bdag a rā gas zhus/ yang si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas mgon po mtshal ser gyi dpe dbang bdag a rā gas thob/ mtshams dam po'i skabs si tu mi 'khrugs chos kyi go cha dang mjal te po ti chen po'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs thob pa'i snang ba byung*/ nyams dang rmi lam 'ga' re la ma mgon gnyis zhal gsal por mjal/ rang gis bsnyen sgrub rtags thon bya/ gzhan la dbang lung phyag khrid byas te bsnyen sgrub byed bcug pa'i rtags thon mang du byung*/ ྃ zhes rdo rje'i gsung 'khrul pa med pas de ltar yang yang bsngags par mdzad de/ mkhas grub 'gro ba'i mgon po a rā ga'am/ karma chags med zhes pa de nyid kyis dul mo chos kyi rje karma dar rgyas la bstsal zhing*/ de nas dpal chen chos kyi don 'grub/ 'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyin byed/ karma pa bdud 'dul rdo rje/ si tu padma nyin byed dbang po/ karma theg mchog bstan 'phel/ 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang blo gros mtha' yas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma che ge mo'i bar rim par brgyud pa'i/ ྃ brgyud pa'i kha skong gsar 'dzud mchan du spel ba'o// dbang lung yod pa tsam ma yin par/ sgrub brgyud byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa dang brten pa ni/ ye shes mgon po 'di nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi rdo rje bzhi'i ngo bo ste/ karma pakshis/ rin chen spungs rgyan mtshams sbyar du/ phyogs bcu'i dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad ye shes rgya mtsho kyai rdo rje la 'dus pa/ de nyid gdul bya'i dbang gis mgon po nag po skad cig tsam gyis rnam par sprul pa las zhes pa'i mkha' spyod dbang pos/ bla ma rgyal ba ma lus pa// 'jigs byed chen mo khyod gcig po// sprul pa kun tu sprul pa ste// de slad rtag tu khyod brten no// bder gshegs kun dngos bla ma mchog

/de nyid nag po khyod gzugs kyis// bdag ni bsrung zhing kun bsrung pa/ the tshom med par bdag bstod do// ces so// rje mthong ba don ldan zhabs kyis/ rgyal ba kun gyi khyab bdag dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbang phyug ston pa rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid chos sdud pa po bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ dpal ma hā kā la yab yum ni/ bcom ldan 'das dang ngo bo gcig kho na ste/ zhes gsungs/ 'phags pa rin chen dpung rgyan gyi rgyud las/ bar snang gi lha rnams kyis nag po chen po la bstod pa las/ bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i sngon rol nas// mtha' yas tshogs rdzogs mngon par sangs rgyas kyang*// thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ pha rol phyin pa bcu yi gtso bor mdzad// sa bcu'i gtso bor mdzad pas chos kyi cod pan mdzes// mgon po spyan ras gzigs ni thugs rje'i mnga' bdag can// nag po lha mchog khyod la bstod de gus phyag 'tshal// ces dang*/ dpal mgon po gzugs gnod sbyin drag po 'dul ba zhes bya ba rta nag zhon pa gtso bo brten pa las mgon po la bstod pa/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs de thugs rje dbang phyug can// yon tan mnga' bdag 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs// zhes so// srog gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal zhing bstod pa/ bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i sngon rol na// mtha' yas mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*// thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ rgyud de nyid las mgon po la phyag na rdo rjes bstod pa/ pha rol phyin pa bcu la spyad pas sa bcu'i gtso bo mdzad// sa bcu'i mgon po gtso bo legs pas chos kyi cod pan mdzes// mgon po spyan ras gzigs de thugs rje mnga' bdag can// ces gsungs shing*/

gsang ba gab thig gi rgyud las kyang de lta bu rgya cher gsungs pa sogs des na mgon po de lta bu'i snyan brgyud kyi dbang zab mo legs par zhu ba'i phyir maṇḍal phul/ de ltar maṇḍal phul ba sngon du song nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ shākya seṅge'i bstan pa la// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// smin byed rim pa bstan du gsol// lan gsum/ yang 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// lan gsum/ da thun mong gi skyabs sems 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum/ da khyed rang gi spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i sku las bdud rtsi babs pas nyams chag sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsgom la yig brgya zlos/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs/ gdong g.yogs mthing ka bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tsakṣu bhandha wa ra ma ṇa ye swa hā/ me tog gi phreng ba re gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ khyed rang skad cig gis ma hā kā la sku mdog mthing nag gri gug thod khrag 'dzin pa yum dang zhal sbyor ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos rgyas btab par bsgom/ de nas dri lan gyis brtags te/ slob dpon gyis/ gang zhig rdo rje nag po che// sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las bdag /bde ba chen por rnam rol pa// de yi dkyil 'khor 'jug 'dod su// zhes pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

khyod dang du ma'i sangs rgyas kun// dbye ba med pa bdag blta yi// bdag ni skal ba bzang po ste// dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par 'tshal// zhes brjod bcug /yol ba bsal nas phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pas rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku// bla ma mgon po'i sku mchog la// bdag ni rnam pa thams cad du// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung*// bla ma mgon po'i gsung mchog la// bdag ni rnam pa thams cad du// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs// bla ma mgon po'i thugs mchog la// bdag ni rnam pa thams cad du// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan mchog /bla ma mgon po'i yon tan la// bdag ni rnam pa thams cad du// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las mchog /bla ma mgon po'i phrin las la// bdag ni rnam pa thams cad du// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje nag po che zhabs phyag 'tshal zhing*// bsam yas mchod pa'i khyad par du mas mchod// 'gal 'khrul nyes pa ma lus rab bshags nas// mngon spyod brtul zhugs 'bar la rjes yi rangs// phrin las rgya mtshos chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol// 'gro ba mtha' dag khyod dang dbyer med pa'i// byang chub chen po bgegs med thob gyur cig /ces lan gsum/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ khyed rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa bsgom la rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsittaṃ utpā da ya mi/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa de brtan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje me tog snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+wam̐ hoḥsiddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ de nas slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhag cing*/

khyod ni rdo rje'i rigs su skyes// nga yi ye shes rdo rje spyan// byin pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur// gang zhig 'di 'dra ma mthong ba'i// drung du smra bar ma byed cig /gal te smras na nyams par 'gyur// de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni// bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par gyis// gal te khyed kyis 'ga' zhig la// 'di smras na ni mgo bo 'gas// snying gar rdo rjes reg cing*/ oṃ de ring he ru ka dpal rang*// khyed kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// de nas bdud rtsi byin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis grub// pañtsa a mri ta u da ka tha tha/ zhes 'khyor chu byin la/ slar rdo rje spyi bor bzhag nas/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi// rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa// khyod kyis skyo ba med par sgrubs// gang yang nga la ma gus min// de bzhin gus par ma byas na// bdud kyis bcom nas ngan 'gror 'gro// de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis// zhes dam bsgrag la/ de nas rigs lnga'i sdom bzung 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas ni/ dus ni 'di nas bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re zhing ni dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum kyis sdom pa bzung*/

de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir maṇḍal phul/ ye shes pa dbab pa'i don du rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ye shes mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bdag la byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ ye shes pa dbab par mdzad du gsol/ dpal thugs kyi mgon po rdo rje mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ ye shes dbab par mdzad du gsol/ dpal sku'i mgon po sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ ye shes dbab par mdzad gsol/ dpal yon tan gyi mgon po rin chen mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ ye shes dbab par mdzad du gsol/ dpal gsung gi mgon po padma mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ ye shes dbab par mdzad du gsol/ dpal phrin las kyi mgon po las kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ ye shes dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams 'greng ste rting pa btegs nas chos 'byung gi phyag rgya spyi bor gyis la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum gyi chu gtor zhing*/ oṃ daṃ ṣṭotka ṭa kyis slob ma bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ las brag steng mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba de'i dbus su pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag dang ma sngo skya gnyis 'od du zhu ba las/ skad cig gis khams gsum za byed dur khrod bdag po 'jigs byed 'bar ba yab yum gyi skur gyur pa ste/

de yang sku mdog dud kha mun chen gyi mdog lta bu rab tu khros pa'i zhal mche ba bzhi gtsigs shing ljags 'gyur ba/ sdang mig rnam par g.yo ba'i spyan gsum 'khyil zhing phyogs bcur lta ba/ glog ltar kham pa'i smin ma dang sma ra 'bar ba/ me stag 'phro ba gyen du langs pa'i dbu skra dmar ser sbrul dang dar gyis bcings shing nor bu rin po che du ma'i rtse bran can gyi thod pa me rab tu 'bar ba'i thod dang ldan pa/ rus pa dang dug sbrul gdug pas dbu dang sku dang yan lag brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang*/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dgu brtsegs dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ gdug pa rnams kyi mgo bo'i phreng ba khrag dang bcas pa'i do shal byas shing*/ khrag gis gos shing me 'bar ba'i gri gug phyag g.yas dag gis gdengs pa'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gsal ba/ yum gyi zhal du stobs bzhin pa'i khrag can gyi thod pa g.yon du 'dzin zhing*/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i gar dang*/ g.yon pas yum la 'khril pa'i tshul can ma lus pa'i bgegs dang dgra yi tshogs za bar mdzad cing cher rab tu 'bar ba'i me'i dbus na rngams pa'i gad mos ma bhyo hūm̐ gi sgra chen po khams gsum khyab par sgrog pas srid gsum zil gyis gnon cing dbang du sdud pa/ 'jig pa mtha' dag 'jigs par byed pa de'i pang du dpal ldan lha mo sku mdog mthing nag tu 'dug pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum mche ba bzhi btsigs pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du bcings shing mthur du grol ba la/ thod skam lnga'i phreng bas bcings pa/ spyi gtsug tu zla ba phyed pa dang*/ rma bya'i mdongs kyis mdzes pa/ dar gyi cod pan dang*/ sbrul nag gi chun 'phyang dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs 'phro ba'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol zhing thod rlon gyi do shal can/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyis yab la 'khril ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/

phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po na kha ṭwām̐ ga rtse gsum bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na 'phrul gyi me long phyi zhing lta ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na gnam lcags kyi phur pa 'dril zhing 'debs pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma na sbrul nag gi zhags pa bsdog cing 'phen pa/ g.yas kyi 'og ma'i phyag gis dpal nag po chen po la 'khyud pa ste/ dpal chen po'i skur gsal btab pa'i dpral bar spyan dbus ma g.yas phyogs su drag tu 'khor ba dang*/ g.yung drung ris dmar po la sems gtad/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ma mgon yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ lus ngag yid gsum la sib sib thim par sgoms shig /hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// dpal ldan mgon po spyan 'dren na// thugs rje'i thugs dam dbang gis ni// bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// bhyo/ byang shar chos dbyings pho brang nas// bstan pa bsrung phyir sku sprul pa// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs ma tshur gshegs// dam tshig dbang gis myur du byon// oṃ ā we sha ya ā we sha ya ma hā kā la de ba raksha dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ e hye hi ā gatstsha ya ā gatstsha ya hūm̐ ya dza hūm̐ ya dza/ zhes yun ring du dbab/ tshil chen bdug /rol mo bya/ ma phebs na dmigs pa bskyar te dbab/ phebs nas/ de ltar phab pa'i ye shes de ngo sprad pa'i phyir rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ kye ho/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid cir yang grub pa med// grub pa med pa'i sems nyid la// sna tshogs snang ba ngo mtshar che// snang tsam nyid la sems su 'dus// sems can kun gyi sems nyid de// bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin// rnam par mi rtog bsam mi khyab// gsal ba de yi ngo bor snang*// mos pa du ma'i sems can la// thabs rnams sna tshogs ston pa ste// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i sbyor ba yis// dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod// bsam gyis mi khyab go 'phang thob// ye shes mgon po'i byin rlabs yin// bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni// sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du// skal ldan rnams kyi spyod yul yin// spyi bor rdo rje reg cing*/

de nas ye shes pa de nyid brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣṭha badzra/ gyis brtan par byas/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthong ba brtag pa ni/ mig ras kyi 'og nas dkyil 'khor gyi bar snang la ltos/ kha dog ji ltar mthong ba smos shig /kha dog ci mthong brjod bcug /de ltar dkar po la zhi ba/ ser po la rgyas pa/ dmar po la dbang*/ ljang gu'am nag po la mngon spyod dam drag po/ kha dog sna tshogs la las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod/ khyed rang rnams la sngar byin pa'i me tog gi phreng ba de skye ba snga ma la las kyi 'phro yod pa'i lha gang yin pa la phog par gyur cig ces yid la gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos/ bde gshegs snying po'i dkyil 'khor du// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe gang la sbyangs pa'i lha// gang yin de la phog par shog /pra tītstsha hoḥ zhes brjod bzhin pas me tog dkyil 'khor la dor zhig /slob dpon gyis lha gang la phog pa brtag la me tog blangs nas/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha de nyid spyi bor thim par mos shig /sems dpa' stobs chen khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rab tu bzung bar bya// mdzes pa'i cod pan 'di yis ni// rigs kyi bdag por dbang bskur ro// pra ti gṛhna swa mi maṃ/ satwa ma hā bā la/ zhes spyi bor sbyin/ rigs kyi ming btags/ dkyil 'khor gtso bos deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed pa ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badzra ha sya udgha ṭa hūm̐/ zhes mig dar bsal/ dag pa dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo bstan cing lha ngo sprad pa ni/ de nas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor ngo sprad par bya ste/ de'ang rdo rje'i brag ri lhun chags pa'i steng du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor zhing ye shes kyi me rlung dmar nag 'tshubs ma dgu klong 'khyil pa'i dbus su rang snang ye shes las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mthing nag gru gsum yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du 'khor lo bzhi rim gyi lte bar pad nyi'i steng du dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan la dkar dmar gyi khams dang gzung 'dzin sogs gnyis chos thams cad dag cing shes rab bden pa gnyis sogs mtshon pa'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po yum lha mo rang byung ma dang gnyis med du 'khril ba/

chos nyid zhi ba'i dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin du thabs mkhas gdug pa 'dul phyir he ru ka rab tu khros pa'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ rtag chad kyi mtha' las grol phyir dre'u rta rkang gsum gyi steng du btsan stabs 'khyil pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o// 'khor lo dang por rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang*/ yul brgyad dag cing de kho na nyid bcu drug mtshon pa'i nag po yab yum bcu drug /'khor lo gnyis par phung po lnga dang khams lnga dag cing sa bcu dang stobs bcu mtshon pa'i phyogs bcu mgon po/ 'khor lo gsum par kun gzhi las 'phros pa'i sems byung gi tshogs dag cing ye shes rnam pa lnga thabs shes kyis dbye ba'i rigs mtshon pa'i dregs pa bdun cu don gnyis/ 'khor lo bzhi par rtsa yi 'khor lo rlung dang thig le dag cing chos nyid bde gshegs snying po'i rang mdangs 'gags pa med pa'i rtsal las shar ba'i ma mo 'dun/ sring mo bzhi/ 'bar ma dgu/ dus bzhi'i lho mo/ dmag gi rgyal mo bzhi/ dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad/ rdo rje brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs sprul pa yang sprul gyi lha tshogs bsam gyi mi khyab cing so so'i rgyan cha lugs phyag mtshan bzhon pa dang bcas pa ma 'dres pa gsal bar mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de dag kyang rang sems kyi snang cha las gzhan du mi dmigs te/ sems kyi ngo bo stong pa ni lha mo/ rang bzhin gsal ba ni mgon po/ ma 'gags pa cir yang 'char ba ni las mkhan 'khor tshogs/ de ltar ye gdod ma nas yin kyang ma rtogs pa'i 'khor ba dang ngan song du 'khyams pa yin la/ de la nyon mongs ye shes su 'gyur ba'i thabs zab mo ni dbang*/ de ngo sprad pa ni bla ma/ de'i don bsgom pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma btsal rang la 'byung ba ni 'bras bu'o// de'ang rnam pa thams cad du dwangs ma'i srog phyag rgya chen po'i lta bas rgyas btab pas gnas lugs rang bzhin gyi mgon po glo bur dri ma'i sbub las grol/

bsgrub bya lam gyi mgon po rang rtsal du shes/ lhun grub 'bras bu'i mgon po rang nas rang byung 'char par 'gyur pa'o// dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor rigs su skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kun// thams cad 'di las 'byung bas na// dam tshig thams cad spyod pa dang*// dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyongs// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis// zhes brjod/ de nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag bzhugs so// rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur// zhes nga rgyal bzung ste de dag ni sngon du bya'o// dngos gzhi 'od kyi dbang sogs zhu ba'i phyir maṇḍal phul/ de nas lha dang bla ma dbyer med pa'i drung du gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gdug pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa// nag po chen po bcom ldan 'das// mkha' 'gro kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes lan gsum/ thig le bris pa'i tsakli gtad pa'am dmigs pa byas kyang rung*/ bla ma ye shes kyi mgon po'i smin mtshams nas 'od dkar po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /sku'i byin rlabs thob par sgoms/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la re ma ti kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ bla ma ye shes kyi mgon po'i mgrin pa nas 'od dmar po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsung gi byin rlabs thob par sgoms/ rtsa sngags dang*/ wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ bla ma ye shes kyi mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od mthing ka byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar thim pas yid kyi sgrib pa dag /thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par sgoms/ rtsa sngags dang*/

tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bla ma ye shes kyi mgon po'i lte ba nas 'od ser po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte bar thim pas bsags pa cha mnyam gyi sgrib ba dag /yon tan gyi byin rlabs thob par sgoms/ rtsa sngags dang*/ sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ bla ma ye shes kyi mgon po'i gsang ba nas 'od ljang nag byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gsang bar thim pas shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /phrin las kyi byin rlabs thob par sgoms/ rtsa sngags dang*/ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa phaṭa/ de ni 'od kyi dbang zhes bya ba'o// bla ma mgon po'i gnas lngar oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥphaṭa dang*/ khyed rang slob ma'i gnas lngar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥphaṭa kyis mtshan par sgoms/ de nas bla ma mgon po'i dpral ba'i oṃ las oṃ mang po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim par sgoms/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ mgon po'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas āḥmang po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim par sgoms/ āḥ.āḥ.āḥ mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ mang po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par sgoms/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ mgon po'i lte ba'i hrīḥlas hrīḥ mang po byung/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i hrīḥl thim par sgoms/ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ mgon po'i gsang ba'i phaṭa las phaṭa mang po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gsang ba'i phaṭa la thim par sgoms/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ de ni sa bon gyi dbang ngo*// tsakli'am dmigs pas kyang rung ste/ bla ma mgon po'i gnas lnga dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas lngar yang oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ āḥlas padma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hrīḥlas rin po che ser po hrīs mtshan pa/ phaṭa las ral gri ljang gu phaṭa kyis mtshan par sgoms/ de nas bla ma mgon po'i dpral ba'i 'khor lo las 'khor lo grangs med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba'i 'khor lo la thim par sgoms/

oṃ badzra ma hā kā la re ma ti tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ mgon po'i mgrin pa'i padma las padma grangs med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i padma la thim par sgoms/ rtsa sngags/ padma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ mgon po'i thugs ka'i rdo rje las rdo rje grangs med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i rdo rje la thim par sgoms/ rtsa sngags/ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ mgon po'i lte ba'i rin po che las rin po che grangs med par 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i rin po che la thim par sgoms/ rtsa sngags/ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ mgon po'i gsang ba'i ral gri las ral gri grangs med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi gsang ba'i ral gri la thim par sgoms/ rtsa sngags/ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa phaṭa/ de ni mtshan ma'i dbang ngo*/ slar yang sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba'i don du maṇḍal phul/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gdul dka' 'dul mdzad bcom ldan 'das// khyod la rtag tu phyag 'tshal nas// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*// phrin las rab 'byams dbang bskur gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag 'grub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// sku yis mngon par dbang bskur ro// oṃ badzra ma hā kā la re ma ti kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes sku yi rten gang yang rung ba mgo bor bkod/ me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ slob ma lhar bskyed pa ni/ oṃ daṃṣṭotka ṭas bsangs/ oṃ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las khyed rang rnams// hūm̐ las mgon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// mthing nag spyan gsum ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs// dbu skra gyen brdzes g.yas pas gri gug dang*// g.yon gyis thod khrag thod skam dbu rgyan can// dug sbrul rus pa sna tshogs dar gyis brgyan// dar nag 'jol ber stag gi sham thabs dang*// mgo phreng do shal zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i gar// g.yon pa brkyang pa'i tshul gyis 'jigs pa'i gzugs// khams gsum dbang sdud zil gnon chen por gyur// de'i pang du/

ma las lha mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma// kha ṭwām̐ phur pa me long sbrul zhags bsnams// btsan stabs 'khril ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur// de yi spyi bor oṃ yig dkar po dang*// mgrin par āḥdamar thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po// mgon po'i thugs kar zla bar hūm̐ mthing nag /lha mo'i thugs kar nyi mar bhyo sngon pos mtshan par gyur// zhes yi ges gsum dang sa bon bkod/ de nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rjes gnang sbyin par bya ste/ de la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bla ma mgon po'i smin mtshams nas sku'i mgon po dkar po grangs med pa 'phros/ rang rang rnams kyi smin mtshams su thim pas sku'i mgon po dkar por sgoms shig /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// sku mgon yab yum dbang bskur ro// oṃ badzra ma hā kā la re ma ti kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ rol mo sogs bya/ bla ma mgon po'i mgrin pa nas gsung gi mgon po dmar po grangs med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas gsung gi mgon po dmar por sgoms shig /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag 'grub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// gsung mgon yab yum dbang bskur ro// rtsa sngags/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ bla ma mgon po'i thugs ka nas thugs kyi mgon po mthing ka grangs med par 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar thim pas thugs kyi mgon po mthing ka sgoms shig /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag 'grub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// thugs mgon yab yum dbang bskur ro// rtsa sngags/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bla ma mgon po'i lte ba nas yon tan gyi mgon po ser po grangs med par 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte bar thim pas yon tan gyi mgon po ser po sgoms shig

/e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag 'grub byed pa// dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral gyi// yon tan mgon po'i dbang bskur ro// rtsa sngags/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ bla ma mgon po'i gsang ba nas phrin las kyi mgon po ljang gu grangs med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi gsang bar thim pas phrin las kyi mgon po ljang gur sgoms shig /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag 'grub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// phrin las mgon po'i dbang bskur ro// rtsa sngags/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa phaṭa/ de ni sku zhal phyag gi dbang ngo*// de nas gsung sngags dbang ni/ da dpon slob gnyis ka lhar gsal ba'i gnas lngar nyi zla la hūm̐ re re/ slob dpon gyi gnas lnga'i hūm̐ gi mthar sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi snying po lnga bkod pa de/ rim pa ltar zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i gnas so sor hūm̐ gi mthar 'khyil te 'khor bar gyur par blta bas/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag 'grub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// spyan 'dren sngags kyis dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā kā la kā la ya/ de ba rakṣa/ dzaḥhūm̐ḥbam̐ḥhoḥ 'dir shog 'dir shog /a gatstsha ya a gatstsha ya/ hūm̐ ya dzaḥhūm̐ ya dzaḥ oṃ ma hā kā li/ trag rakṣa tiṃ laṃ/ sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ḥbam̐ḥhoḥ nag mo tiṃ laṃ ma ma dun bhyo/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ḥhoḥ ka li dun bhyo/ e ā ralli hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ḥhoḥ ma ti ma hā sa ma ya/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ ma ma ya sha ra sha ka la/ sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ a la la hoḥ ma mo nag mo ting lam̐ḥ ma mo nag mo dun tiṃ bhyo/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ nag mo dun bhyo/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sa ma ya/ e hye hi dzaḥ a ralli hoḥ hriṃ hriṃ/ wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes rdo rje dpral bar reg /rol mo bya/ me tog gtor ba kun la 'gre/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// her ni'i sngags kyis dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā kā la kā la ya/

shog her ni shog /her ma duṃ ril shog /'dir shog 'dir shog /'dir duṃ 'dir duṃ/ gnod byed dgra po'i tsitta bam̐ tsitta rbad/ wakka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes rdo rje mgrin par reg /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// hu ra'i sngags kyis dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā kā la kā la ya/ de wa rakṣa dgra bo'i tsitta la hu ra hu ra/ be ra be ra/ du na du na/ tri liṃ shaṃ ka ru tri ta trag rakṣa rbad/ oṃ st+waṃ bandha st+waṃ bandha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes rdo rje snying gar reg /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// shā sa na yi sngags dbang bskur// oṃ ma hā kā la kā la ya/ shā sa naṃ/ u pa kā ri naṃ/ e ṣā pashtsi ma kā lo yaṃ/ i daṃ ratna tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri naṃ/ ya ti pra ti dzñā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣṭaṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ wakka a bhi ṣiñtsa.āḥ zhes rdo rje lte bar reg /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// rbad sngags kyi ni dbang bskur ro// oṃ e ā ralli hoḥ shrī ma hā kā la khā hi/ trag rakṣa khā hi/ tra rakṣa thun bhyo khā hi/ trag rakṣa rbad bhyo khā hi/ wakka a bhiṣiñtsa āḥ zhes rdo rje gsang bar reg /de ni gsung bzlas pa'i dbang ngo*// ra ra si si la sogs sngon tu 'gro bas bya ba sngags kyi dbang ngo*// thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang ni/ slob dpon gyi dpral ba nas 'od zer mthing skya 'phros/ khyed rang gi dpral bar thim/ gti mug gi las sgrib dag /chos dbyings ye shes thob par bsgom/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// thugs kyis mngon par dbang bskur ro// oṃ badzra ma hā kā la re ma ti tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

rdo rje dpral bar reg /me tog dang rol mo kun la 'gre'o// slob dpon gyi mgrin pa nas 'od zer mthing dmar 'phros/ khyed rang gi mgrin par thim/ 'dod chags kyi las sgrib dag /sor rtog ye shes thob par sgoms/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// thugs kyis mngon par dbang bskur ro// rtsa sngags/ tsitta a bhi ṣañtsa hūm̐/ rdo rje mgrin par reg /slob dpon gyi thugs ka na 'od zer mthing nag 'phros/ khyed rang gi snying gar thim/ zhe sdang gi las sgrib dag /me long ye shes thob par sgoms/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// thugs kyis mngon par dbang bskur ro// rtsa sngags/ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ snying gar reg /slob dpon gyi lte ba nas 'od zer mthing ser 'phros/ khyed rang gi lte bar thim/ nga rgyal gyi las sgrib dag /mnyam nyid ye shes thob par sgoms/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// thugs kyis mngon par dbang bskur ro// rtsa sngags/ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ lte bar reg /slob dpon gyi gsang ba nas 'od zer mthing ljang 'phros/ khyed rang gi gsang bar thim/ phrag dog gi las sgrib dag /bya grub ye shes thob par sgoms/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// thugs kyis mngon par dbang skur ro// rtsa sngags/ tsitta a bhi ṣ-iñtsa hūm̐/ gsang bar reg /de ni thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang ngo*// de nas yon tan rgyan gyi dbang la/ oṃ daṃ ṣṭotka ṭas bsangs/ oṃ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rgyan re re bzhin rin po che dang*/ rus pa dang*/ sbrul dang*/ zhing pags dang*/ stag pags dang*/ dar lhab lhub dang*/

mgo phreng rnams su bskyed de/ de la khro rgyal thams cad kyi nus mthu ji snyed pa bsdus nas thim par gyur par dmigs shing bstim/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// rin po che yi rgyan cha yi// yon tan mngon par dbang bskur ro// oṃ badzra ma hā kā la re ma ti ratna a laṃ ka ra gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// rus pa yi ni rgyan drug gi /yon tan mngon par dbang bskur ro// rtsa sngags dang*/ ru ni raṃ su a laṃ ka ra gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// sbrul rgyan kha dog brgyad po yi// yon tan mngon par dbang bskur ro// rtsa sngags dang*/ nā ga aṣṭa a laṃ ka ra gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// nga rgyal 'joms byed zhing lpags kyi// yon tan mngon par dbang bskur ro// rtsa sngags dang*/ ma nu ṣya dṛ ti a laṃ ka ra gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// mgo phreng lnga bcu'i do shal gyi// /yon tan mngon par dbang bskur ro// rtsa sngags dang*/ kā pa la mā la a laṃ ka ra gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs kyi// yon tan mngon par dbang bskur ro// rtsa sngags dang*/ e bya gṝ wast+ra gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// lhab lhub dar gyi ber chen gyi// yon tan mngon par dbang bskur ro// rtsa sngags dang*/

wast+ra a laṃ ka ra gu ṇa a bhi ṣ-iñtsa hūm̐/ zhes sogs tsakli'am/ dmigs pas byas kyang rung*/ de ni yon tan rgyan kyi dbang ngo*// de bzhin du thod pa chang gis bkang ba dang*/ gri gug gtad/ oṃ daṃṣṭotka ṭa/ oṃ swā bha wa/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i gri gug lag g.yas su byin pas bgegs mtha' dag gi mgo gcod/ me 'bar 'od kyis gdug pa can thams cad bsreg /sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa gsal bar bsgom/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// phrin las mchog gi dbang bskur ro// badzra karta ri karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod de gri gug lag g.yas su sbyin/ a las byung ba'i thod pa lag g.yon du byin pas khams gsum kun gyi bcud bsdus gsol bas zad pa med par bsgom/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// phrin las mchog gi dbang bskur ro// badzra ka pā la karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes thod pa lag g.yon du sbyin/ de nas lcags kyu sogs gtad la/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// 'gugs byed lcags kyu'i dbang bskur ro// badzra aṅku sha karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// 'ching byed zhags pas dbang bskur ro// badzra pā sha karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// sdom byed lcags sgrog dbang bskur ro// badzra spho ṭa karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ e ma skal ldan rigs gyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// myos byed dril bu'i dbang bskur ro// badzra gaṇṭe karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

las bzhi pa'i phyag rgya bris pa sbyin/ phrin las so so'i dmigs pa 'khrul 'khor rgyas par bya zhes gsungs phyir/ las bzhi'i phyag rgya byin pas las bzhi mtha' dag 'grub par sgoms shig /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// las bzhi'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur ro// shantiṃ puṣṭiṃ wa shaṃ mā ra ya karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bing sogs khyad par gyi phyag mtshan sbyin par spro na/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// phyag mtshan bing dang par bu'i dbang bskur ro// gaṇṭi ka ṭo ra karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de ni phrin las phyag mtshan gyi dbang zhes bya'o// bla ma mgon por gsal ba'i gar dgu'i nyams rnams slob ma la 'phros/ slob ma rnams kyang gar dgu'i nyams chen po rab tu 'bar ba'i bdud la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs su gyur pa thams cad tshar bcad/ snying ga'i sa bon las byung pa'i mchod pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcur spros pas rgyal ba mtha' dag dgyes par gyur/ rdo rje khro bo rnams kyi ni// yon tan rmad byung gar dgu ste// sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// rgod dang drag shul 'jigs par byed// snying rje rngams dang zhi ba ste// gar nyams phul byung dbang bskur ro// nṛ tya a bhi ṣiñtsi hūm̐/ de ni gar nyams phul byung gi dbang ngo*// bla ma mgon po'i 'od kyis slob ma mgon por gnas par bskul/ de'i 'od kyis gnod byed thams cad bskrad par bsgom/ rtsa sngags/ u tsa ta ya phaṭa/ bla ma mgon po'i 'od kyis slob ma mgon por gnas pa bskul/ de'i 'od kyis gnod byed thams cad bsad par sgoms/ rtsa sngags/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bla ma mgon po'i 'od kyis slob ma mgon por gnas par bskul/ de'i 'od kyis gnod byed thams cad rmongs par sgoms/ rtsa sngags/

bid de sha ya phaṭa/ bla ma mgon po'i 'od kyis slob ma mgon por gnas par bskul/ de'i 'od kyis gnod byed thams cad rengs par sgoms/ rtsa sngags/ bandha sha ya phaṭa/ zhi rgyas dbang dgug rnams rgyas par bsgom pa phrin las kyi dbang ste/ bla ma mgon po'i sku las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar sgoms/ rtsa sngags/ shwantiṃ ku ru a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bla ma mgon po'i sku las 'od zer ser po gser mdog 'phros/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par sgoms/ rtsa sngags/ puṣṭiṃ ku ru a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bla ma mgon po'i sku las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ snang srid dbang du bsdus par sgoms/ rtsa sngags/ wa shaṃ ku ru a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bla ma mgon po'i sku las 'od zer ljang nag 'phros/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par sgoms/ rtsa sngags/ mā ra ya phaṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes pa rnams kyang phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba'o// de ltar dbang dgu po 'di dag gang yang rung ba re re 'am/ gsum tshan gang rung ngam tshang bar slob ma snod du rung mi rung gi dbye bas brtag la sbyin no// shin tu skal pa mchog dang ldan pa dag slar yang maṇḍal phul te zhes gsungs pas/ da thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu bskur ba la dang por bum pa'i dbang gi don du maṇḍal/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung chen po yis// bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur stsol// byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod cing ji ltar gsol ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su dbang gi stegs su gnas pa la/ oṃ daṃ ṣṭotka ṭa kyis bsangs/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bum chu dang slob ma rnams hūm̐ yig mthing nag las byung ba'i dpal thugs kyi mgon po mthing nag rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje dang me long 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rus pa dang*/ rin po che la sogs rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par thim/ thugs kyi mgon po yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum chur gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis spyan drangs pa nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs la mngon par bskul/ khro bo rnams kyi bgegs bskrad/ yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ bcom ldan 'das nag po chen po sogs phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis gang ba cung zad yo bar 'dzin pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar mos pa gyis/ bum pa spyi bor reg cing*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje'i bdag /dpal ldan khrag 'thung chen po yi// zhe sdang 'joms byed chu yi dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ badzra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ dag pa bzang pos dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ā hūm̐/ bum chu blud/ de ltar chu'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dag /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi dbang thob/ chu yi lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas dbu rgyan sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dbu rgyan dang slob ma rnams hūm̐ yig ser po dag las byung ba'i dpal yon tan gyi mgon po ser po rin po ches mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/

yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma nor bu dang dpag bsam 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rus pa dang*/ rin po che la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par thim/ yon tan gyi mgon po yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs pa nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs la mngon par bskul/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ bcom ldan 'das nag po chen po sogs phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis rin po che'i dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bar sgoms/ dbu rgyan sbyin zhing*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje'i bdag /dpal ldan khrag 'thung chen po yi// nga rgyal 'joms byed cod pan dbang*// de ring khyed la bskur bar bya// oṃ ratna mu ku ṭaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs chu yis dbang bskur/ de ltar dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dag /mnyam nyid ye shes kyi dbang thob/ chu yi lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dang*/ slob ma rnams hūm̐ yig dmar po las byung ba'i dpal gsung gi mgon po dmar po padma dmar pos mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yum padma mkha' 'gro ma na bza' dang padma 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rus pa dang*/ rin po che la sogs rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim/ gsung gi mgon po yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis spyan drangs pa nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs la mngon par bskul/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod ba'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ bcom ldan 'das nag po chen po sogs phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i dbang bskur bar sgoms/ rdo rje lag tu gtad de/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje'i bdag /dpal ldan khrag 'thung chen po yi// 'dod chags 'joms byed rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyed la bskur bar bya// oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ ji ltar bltams pa sogs chu yis dbang bskur/ de ltar rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag /sor rtog ye shes kyi dbang thob/ chu lhag yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas dril bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang yas pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dril bu dang slob ma rnams hūm̐ yig ljang gu las byung ba'i phrin las kyi mgon po ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yum las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ral gri dang rgya gram 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rus pa dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim/ phrin las kyi mgon po yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis spyan drangs pa nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs la mngon par bskul/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ bcom ldan 'das nag po chen po sogs phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis dril bu'i dbang bskur bar sgoms/

dril bu sbyin zhing*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje'i bdag /dpal ldan khrag 'thung chen po yi// phrag dog 'joms byed dril bu'i dbang*// deng 'dir khyed la bskur bar bya// oṃ badzra gaṇṭe a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ ji ltar bltams pa sogs chu yis dbang bskur/ de ltar dril bu'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa phrag dog dag /bya grub ye shes kyi dbang thob/ chu yi lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur// de nas slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dbang rdzas dang slob ma rnams hūm̐ yig dkar po las byung pa'i dpal sku'i mgon po dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma bum pa dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rus pa dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim/ sku'i mgon po yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i rdor dril du gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis spyan drangs pa nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs la mngon par bskul/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ bcom ldan 'das nag po chen po sogs phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs ba rnams kyis rdo rje'i ming gi dbang bskur bar sgoms/ slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje'i bdag /dpal ldan khrag 'thung chen po yi// gti mug 'joms byed ming gi dbang*/ deng 'dir khyed la bskur bar bya// oṃ badzra na ma a bhi ṣi ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// ji ltar bltams pa sogs chu yis dbang bskur/

de lhar ming gi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa gti mug dag /chos dbyings ye shes kyi dbang thob/ chu yi lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba'i don du maṇḍal/ de nas slob dpon nag po chen po'i dbang blang bar 'dod pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis rtag tu slob dpon bgyi// lan gcig /dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su seng ge dang*/ glang po che dang*/ rta mchog dang*/ rma bya dang*/ shang shang gis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri dang*/ padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i slob ma hūm̐ mthing kha las byung ba'i dpal nag po chen po chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i mdog dang thabs dang shes rab kyi phyag dang*/ rnam par rtog pa'i dri ma ma lus 'joms shing nyon mongs pa'i ljon shing gcod pa'i khrag dang bcas pa'i thod pa dang*/ me lce'i phreng ba 'phro ba'i gri gug thugs ka dang snyan gyi thad du 'dzin pa/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i zhabs skyil krung phyed pa'i tshul du 'gying bas gnas shing*/ rgyan dang cha lugs bdag nyid rdo rje lta bu'i bde bas dgyes bar byed cing*/ btsan stabs 'khyil ba'i gar gyis rol pa/ rnam par bkra ba'i lha'i gos kyis yang dag par bklubs pa/ rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan la sogs pas kun nas brgyan cing*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen pos gang ba'i sku can/ rab tu 'bar ba'i me'i dbus na rnam par mdzes pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag /sku gsung thugs kyi snying pos bskor zhing 'od dang bcas pa'o// rdo rje slob dpon bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal nag po chen po'i sku grangs med pa mdun du gshegs par gyur/

oṃ ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ nag po chen po bcom ldan 'das// gdug pa ma lus 'dul mdzad cing*// khams gsum las rgyal drag shul can// dpa' bo chen po la phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ dpal chen rdo rje 'dzin dbang po// mtha' yas thugs rje'i stobs mnga' ba// sems can kun don bsgrub pa'i phyir// 'di la 'jug cing byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje slob ma gnyis su med par zhugs shing gang la gang 'dul gyis 'gro ba'i don sgrub pa la chu nang du snang ba'i nyi zla'i gzugs lta bu'i sangs rgyas rnams las lhag pa nam mkhar gnas pa'i nyi zla 'od 'bar ba lta bu'i rdo rje slob dpon du gyur zhing*/ slar rdo rje slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha tshogs rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs badzra sa mā dzaḥ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma dang bcas pas/ bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyis gang ba phyag gis cung zad yo ba 'dzin pa/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas pas dbang bskur bzhin pa dang*/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'i chu mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bos dbang bskur bar gyur pa ni/ bum pa'i kha rgyan rdo rje dang bcas pa slob ma'i spyi bor reg la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen mo ni// khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa// rdo rje gsang ba gsum byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dbang bskur bas/ bde ba chen po phun sum tshogs par gyur pa'i spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang lha mo rnams ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor bcug par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/

rdo rje lag pa g.yas su gtad la/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje thabs de kho na nyid kyi rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig zungs shig /dril bu g.yon du byin la/ āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu shes rab de kho na nyid kyi dril bu gsung gi dam tshig zungs shig /'khyud pa'i tshul byed du bcug la/ 'khyud pas yum dang bcas pa sbyor ba kha sbyor gyi rim pas phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig zungs shig /yang rdo rje dang dril bu lag tu gtad la/ rdo rje dang ni dril bu longs// rdo rje la ni rab tu gnas// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// de dag ni phyir mi ldog pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// de nas bzlas pa'i lung gi don du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ma hā kā li trag rakṣa/ ma hā kā la kā la ya/ yakṣa be tā li hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ shri ma hā kā la yakṣa be tā li hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la yakṣa gu na hrīḥd hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥswā hā/ oṃ trag rakṣa dun ting ma bhyo/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la ya shā sa naṃ/ u pa ka ri nāṃ e ṣā pashtsi ma kā lo yaṃ/ duṃ duṃ rakṣa tshal pa ha la duṣṭaṃ sha trūm̐ ta thā ru tri pi ti/ dha mi ratna tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇa/ ya dī pra ti dzña/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ ma ma duṣṭaṃ shā trūm̐ de ba bha si dha na mi/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ke na/ dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nang sgrub dang gsang sgrub kyi sngags sbyin/ bdud la sogs pa gzhom pa'i phyir yang dag pa'i mda' gzhu sbyin pa ni/ chos nyid gzhu la ye shes mda'// phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu 'phang*// bdud rnams bcom pas de bzhin gshegs// thams cad rjes su mnyes par gyis// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya swa/ zhes mda' gzhu sbyin/ phyogs mtshams su 'phang bar mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos/

a nu rā ga ya mi/ ces mda' 'phang tshul byed bcug /khro bo'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gser gyi thur mas slob ma'i mig gis sgrib g.yogs ḍāṃ ser por gnas pa gsal bar mos/ mig thur thogs la/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib mun bsal ltar// bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badzra nai tya a pa hā ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ zhes brjod de sgrib g.yogs bsal bas mig sman byugs pa'i tshul bya'o// a yig las skyes pa'i me long 'di bstan pas chos thams cad gzugs brnyan dang*/ sgyu ma lta bur rtogs shing khong du chud par mos mdzod/ me long bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan dag dang mtshungs// dag cing gsal la rnyogs pa med// bzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las mnyam par byung*// rang bzhin med cing gnas dang bral// chos rnams de ltar ngas shes nas// sems can don ni mtshungs med gyis/ khyod ni 'dren pa rnams su skyes// zhes brjod/ de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur don du maṇḍal/ gsang ba'i dbang gi don du 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdo rje 'dzin pa nag po che// mchog gi bde ba'i gter chen po// mkha' 'gro kun gyi dbang phyug gis// bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsol*// zhes gsol ba btab/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs 'ching bar mdzod/ bla ma mgon po bai tā li dang sbyor ba/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i bu ga bai yig gis mtshan pa/ a las skyes pa'i padma 'dab ma gsum pa ṭām̐ yig ser pos mtshan pa'i ze'u 'bru can thabs dang shes rab kyis 'gyur ba yang dag pa'i spyod lam gyis gnas pa'i bla ma'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad bkug spyi bo nas zhugs/ bde ba dam pa myong bar 'dod pa'i mes zhu/ dbus su gnas pa'i rtsa'i lam nas brgyud de lhan cig gnas pa'i gnas blangs pa'i byang sems/

slob ma'i lce thog tu bzhag pas lus thams cad khyab/ rtsa gnas bzhir dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong bar sgoms/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā kā la re ma ti gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi thod pa gzhan du spel la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes hub gsum gyis rol/ rtsa 'khor sbyang pa'i dmigs pa rgyas par bya/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs sol cig /de ltar dbang bskur bas/ bla ma mgon po yab yum las byung ba'i bdud rtsis lus thams cad gang*/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba phul du byung ba rgyud la skyes/ rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa la sogs pa sngags bzlas ba'i skal ba 'jog /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mnyam pa nyid dang*/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mthar phyin par byed pa'i lam gyi mchog tu gyur pa gsang ba'i dbang bla na med pa'o// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i don du maṇḍal/ sher dbang gi don du 'di'i rjes zlos/ gang gi srid las rnam grol lam// bde dang stong pa dbyer med pa// rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod nyid kyis// shes rab ye shes bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs 'ching bar mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo las sprul pa'i lha mos khyed cag rnams 'dri ba'i tshul gyis smras pa/ bde chen la dga' nyid dam bu// khrag la sogs pa za byed cing*// padma'i dkyil 'khor brtsam pa na// bu yis smras te ci bde bar// zhes pa la lan gdab pa'i tshul gyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpa' mo bdag ni ci mi spro// ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams// yon tan dam pa bskyed pa'i phyir// nyams pa med par bsrung bar bgyi// de skad ces gsol ba btab pa las/

lha mo de nyid kyang bcom ldan 'das bai tā lir gsal bas chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dkyil 'khor ston bzhin bas/ a hoḥbadag gi padma 'di// bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan// gang zhig cho gas brten byed pa// de yi mdun na bdag gnas so// sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa// padmar bya ba ji bzhin gyis// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// badzra bhañdza mo kṣa hoḥ zhes smra bar byed pa rdo rje slob dpon gyis lag tu gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /zhes rig ma'i tsakli sbyin pa'i me long sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor spyi bor bzhag la/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// shes rab mchog gi dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā kā la re ma ti pradzña dzña na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ sindhū ra snying gar byugs/ slob ma mgon por gsal ba la bla mas mkha' 'gro ma du ma sbyin pas dpal ldan lha mo snying gar thim par sgoms/ shes rab ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs sol cig /de ltar dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ tsanḍa li'i man ngag dam pa bsgom pa'i skal ba bzhag /chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i lam gyi ngo bo shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bla na med pa'o// de nas bzhi pa'i dbang bskur ba'i don maṇḍal/ tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i don du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang zhig med bzhin snang ba po// skye med las skyes spros bral thugs// don dam rdo rje nag po ches// bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs bcing bar mdzod/ dbang bzhi pa'i don lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la bskyed pa'i phyir/ lus ma bcos pa rdo rje skyil krung*/ ngag ma bcos pa brjod pa dang bral ba/ sems ma bcos pa chos kyi sku spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/

mnyam nyid gdod nas dag pa chen po/ dgag pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i tshul dang bral ba'i chos nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ ces brjod la mnyam par bzhag /de mtshon pa'i phyir gri gug lag tu gtad de/ lam 'di nyid phyin ci ma log par mtshon na ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid kyi rdo rje dang rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags ma lus pa/ gcod par 'gyur ba'i gri gug ste 'di ni brda tsam du shes par gyis shig /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// phrin las mtha' dag sgrub byed pa// dpal ldan nag po lcam dral gyi// ye shes chen pos dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā kā la re ma ti tsa tur artha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes rig stong dbyer med pa'i don ngo sprad/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs sol cig /de ltar dbang bskur bas bya ba dang mi bya ba'i mtha' dang bral ba yin yang*/ kun rdzob ltar tshig gi yul du ma gyur pa phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang ba'i skal ba bzhag /ngo bo nyid kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i lam gyi gtso bo bzhi ba'i dbang bla na med pa ste 'di dag dngos gzhi'i don no// mchog gi dbang gsum po re re zhing yang rol mo la sogs pa sngar bzhin bya'o// de nas rigs lnga'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ lag tu 'khor lo gtad la byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas 'dzin du bcug la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// khyod kyis sems can gti mug can rnams kyi don gyis shig /rdo rje lag tu byin la/ sa gnon dang mnyam par bzhag pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// rdo rje'i 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// khyod kyis sems can zhe sdang can rnams kyi don gyis shig

/rin po che lag tu byin la/ mchog sbyin dang mnyam bzhag gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// nor bu'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// khyod kyis sems can nga rgyal can rnams kyi don gyis shig /padma lag tu byin la/ mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas/ de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// padma'i 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// khyod kyis sems can 'dod chags can rnams kyi don gyis shig /sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu bzhag /skyabs sbyin dang mnyam bzhag gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa// rgya gram 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// khyod kyis sems can phrag dog can rnams kyi don gyis shig /rigs lnga'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig pa'i rjes su gnang ba'o// de nas slob dpon sprul sku'i cha lugs lag g.yon chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar 'dzin pa snying gar bzung ba dang*/ g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas/ de ring ngas khyod lung bstan te// 'od dpag med pa de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pa na// srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun las grol// kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi sa ma ya st+waṃ ra wa swa/ ma 'ongs pa na rigs kyi gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur te/ gang 'di ji ltar lung bstan pa de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan thob pa yin te/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can 'dul bar dka' ba rnams kyi don du de bzhin gshegs pa thams can gcig tu bsdus pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzugs su gyur pas bde ba la 'god par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na khyod kyis deng phan chad dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po sgrubs shig

/zhes rjes gnang lung bstan byas la/ khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che// rgyal ba'i sras po brtas gyur pas// de ni bdud las rnam rgyal pa// grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin// zhes dbugs dbyung*/ de nas gtor ma ye shes dang las dang 'jig rten gyi srung ma mtha' dag sdud pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ par bskyed la spos rol dbyangs dang bcas te/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs 'di la dgongs nas kyang*// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas// sras mchog nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs// 'dir gshegs 'di la dgongs nas kyang*// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// ri rab mchog gi steng shed nas// 'jig rten mgon po gzi brjid can// 'dir gshegs 'di la dgongs nas kyang*// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// mthong ba tsam gyis bdud kyi dpung*// kun nas skrag par byed pa ste// ma hā kā la khyed kyi zhal// 'di la de ring bstan du gsol// las bzhi grub pa chen po brgyad// skad cig yud kyis 'grub byed pa// sngags kyi dngos grub chen po de'ang*// 'di la de ring stsal du gsol// byams pa'i thugs kyis 'di la dgongs// brtse ba'i spyan gyis 'di la gzigs// lung bstan rjes su gnang ba yi// bka' stsal 'di la gnang du gsol// bhyo/ ma cig smin mtshams mdzod spu yi// 'od zer gyi ni drwa ba las// sku yi sprul pa grangs med 'gyed// dpal ldan lha mo re ma dzaḥ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// ma cig ljags kyi dbang po yi// 'od zer gyi ni drwa ba las// gsung gi sprul pa grangs med 'gyed// dpal ldan lha mo re ma dzu// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// ma cig thugs kyi dpal be'u yi// 'od zer gyi ni drwa ba las// thugs kyi sprul pa grangs med 'gyed// dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i bdud bcom nas// thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra ma hā kā la re ma ti kā ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐/
