zhes gtor ma mgor bkod/ smin mtshams mgrin pa snying ga gsum du gtugs la rol mo bya/ slar yang mgor bkod la/ chos sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon dha na sang kṛ ta/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ lha sras sad na legs/ stag nam mkha'i lha bzung*/ sngags rab nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ skyes mchog karma pakshi la sogs zhal sbyor par nag gi brgyud pa rnams dang*/ ḍombhi he ru ka chen po/ bi na pa/ lwa ba pa/ ind+ra bhu ti/ tsarya pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ dwags po/ dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs pa zhal sbyor snyan brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ slob dpon chen po padma saṃ bha wa/ pu rang pa zhangs btsun dar ma rin chen/ gtsang la stod kyi khyung po stag sham can/ kyu ra rgyal ba ye shes/ phyag bla chen mgon po/ stong dpon shes rab mgon po/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs yum rkyang brgyud pa rnams dang*/ slob dpon arkha pa/ mal gyo lo tsā ba/ gnyal pa nyi ma 'bar/ gnyal pa jo sras/ 'gro mgon ras chen/ rin po che spom brag pa/ chos rje karma pa/ bla ma mnyan ras/ chos rje rin po che rang byung rdo rje la sogs ba rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dpal nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis sgrub pa po 'di yi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du mi 'bral bar phrin las dang sdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ ces dang*/ rtsa sngags mang du brjod/ dkyil 'khor gzhal yas sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par dmigs la dam rdzas longs spyod/ de nas khyed rnams dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur zab mo thob pas yid dga' ba chen pos 'di'i rjes zlos/

deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas// bdag ni gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas// de ring sangs rgyas 'bras bur skyes// sangs rgyas sras su bdag gyur to// zhes gzengs bstod/ de ltar ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan ber nag can yab yum gyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa yin pas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig spyi dang*/ khyad par bya nag khyi nag la rdo mi brdeg pa dang*/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi mos gus brtan pos gsol mchod bsnyen sgrub mi chags pa sogs/ dam tshig gi rim pa rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal phul/ zhes dang*/ lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa 'bul snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran sogs kyis lus 'bul/ bsngo ba smon lam bya/ gtor tshogs rgyas par bya ba sogs rjes kyi cho ga ci rigs par bya ste/ dpal nag po chen po'i dbang rgyas par blang ba'i cho ga'o// gal te gtor ma tsam la brten par 'dod na/ rten gtor byin gyis brlabs steng du mgon po bsgom/ rgyun gtor rgyas par 'bul/ bzlas pa dang mchod bstod rdzogs pa'i tshe maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab/ skyabs sems sngon tu 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin rgyas par bya ste ye shes phab la/ slar yang maṇḍal gsol gdab byas nas/ dbang dgu po gang rung re'am/ gsum tshan nam dgu char byin zhing gtor ma mgor bkod de/ bka' bsgo bzlas lung sbyin/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i lhag ma dngos grub tu longs spyod/ de ltar na dbang so sor dgu dang*/ dgu po rdzogs pa gcig dang bcu/ de'i steng du dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i mchog dbang ste bcu gcig go// da lta ni gtor dbang chung ngu tsam du las gzhan sbas te mi snang bar mdzad pa yin no// 'di dag rje mar pa'i man ngag dang*/ 'gro mgon ras chen gyi dbang chog chen mo las bsdus te bla ma'i zhal gdams ltar bris so// ma hā kā la'i dbang gi tshul// mdor bsdus man ngag ji bzhin bris// gzhan la med par nges pa ste// rab tu gsang zhing sba bar bya// dpal nag po chen po'i dbang gi cho ga'i rim pa mkha' spyod pas mos pa lhur byas te/

mtshur gyi phu 'jig rten dbang po zhal gzigs kyi gtsug lag khang du bris pa'o// zhes dang dga' ston gyi cho ga la sogs kyi mtha' rgyan 'di ni cung zad rgyas pa'o// bsdus par na gtor ma gnas lngar bkod ba dang*/ sngags kyi rjes su zlos pa tsam yang rung ste/ deng sang yongs su grags pa ni de tsam mo/ dbang bzhi bsdus te bskur ba'i tshul 'di ni shin tu zab pa ste sba bar byas so// rigs bsdus sogs kyi cho ga ni gzhan du shes so// ma hā kā la lcam dral gyi// zhal gdams smin byed cho ga'i khrigs// brjod la 'gal ba rnams bshags shing*// dge bas sangs rgyas kun 'grub shog /ma hā kā la zhal sbyor gyi dbang rim shog dril dag tu 'thor ba bsdus te mkha' spyod dbang pos gnod mdzes mkhar du bgyis pa'o// zhes pa rje mkha' spyod dbang pos mdzad pa'i ma yig bu yig gnyis byung ba bcos bslad med par karma a rā gas gab sprad pa'i yi ge pa ni dge slong brtson 'grus te/ 'khrugs bsal pa dang 'gres bshang ba tsam ma gtogs bcos bslad med pas yid ches kyi gnas su bya'o// de ltar ye shes mgon po lcam dral gyi dkyil 'khor dbang chen dpal mkha' spyod pas mdzad pa'i yig cha rnams a rā gas gab sprad pa de nyid sor bzhag /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi/ dbang don ngo sprod mtshams sbyor rnams/ rje mthong ba don ldan gyi gsung ji lta bar bkod pa 'di rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi don du bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'gro mgon ras chen pa'i skyes rabs phreng 'dzin si tu padma'i ming can gyis dpal spungs chos 'khor du spel ba la/ 'gal ba mchis na bshags shing dge bas sgrub brgyud bstan pa mi nub rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgreng ba'i rgyan du shog /sarba madga laṃ/ dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /
